Final for Publication

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 3240 West Lawrence Avenue, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning:  B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

Lot Area: 6,250 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to adapt and reuse the existing five-story
commercial building to establish a mixed-use building that will contain
approximately 1,972.27 sq. ft. of retail space and one (1) residential
dwelling unit at grade and twenty-five (25) residential dwelling units above.
The existing building’s height and footprint will remain without change.
The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will not provide off-
street parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-
1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
reduce the residential off-street parking ratio from 50% (13 parking spaces)
to zero, reduce the rear setback for floors containing residential units from
30 ft. to 7.62 ft. and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the
Chicago Zoning code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 29,023.36 square feet (4.64 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 240 square feet per D.U.
(26 dwelling units proposed)

© The amount of off-street parking: zero

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the Lawrence CTA Bus Route. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the
Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking ratio from 50% (13 parking
spaces) to zero.

(D) _ Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero

b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: Zeto
East Side: zero

c. Rear Setback: 7.62 feet

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback
for floors containing residential units from 30 feet to 7.62 feet.

(E) Building Height: 70 feet
